entities.name: ESM INFORMATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to request ESM information such as protocol configuration options, APN, or both.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer associated with the ESM procedure.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: Identifies the transaction for the ESM procedure.

entities.name: ESM information request message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as ESM INFORMATION REQUEST.

entities.name: Direction: network to UE
entities.description: Specifies that the message is sent from the network to the UE.
